experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Build across Shopify Checkout and Checkout Extensibility, including Shopify Functions, Checkout UI extensions and Shop Pay, and review the code partner developers submit into that execution path.
Judge submitted extension and Functions code against written correctness, performance and edge-case guidelines, recording a pass or fail decision and the line-level reason behind it.
Write the reference implementations and acceptance tests that define what a correct extension does, so a reviewer compares a submission against a known-good answer.
Check generated merchant copy from Shopify Magic against published accuracy and tone criteria before a store sees it, and write the corrected wording when an output falls short.
Sample completed reviews for quality and reconcile the cases where two reviewers disagreed, revising the guideline wording that let them read the same rule differently.

experience.title: Founding Software Engineer
bullets: Built the first version of Felix's online care platform as a founding engineer, taking a patient from intake questionnaire through clinician review to a prescription order ahead of the public launch.

Developed the clinician review tooling that let licensed physicians assess each intake against written clinical criteria, approve or decline treatment and message the patient, replacing the email and phone follow-up the first cases ran on.
Labelled and re-checked intake submissions against the approval criteria during the launch period, working through each queue case by case and flagging the ones the written rules did not yet cover.
Authored the review guidelines and decision rubrics clinicians applied to each intake, and revised them from disagreement cases so two reviewers reached the same decision on the same patient.
Hardened how the platform handled personal health information as the service grew across provinces, adding access controls and audit trails around every clinician and pharmacy action.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Built store-operations features in Dynamics 365 for Retail, including point-of-sale flows that let retailers ring up sales, returns and exchanges the same way in stores and online.

Reviewed code across the retail server and point-of-sale components against the team's checklist, checking correctness, performance under load and backward compatibility before changes shipped on the servicing train.

Triaged and classified incoming customer-reported retail defects against the severity and area definitions, reproducing each one and recording the evidence support engineers needed to confirm the classification.

Diagnosed performance and reliability defects in the retail server under peak trading load, isolating the root cause from profiling data and reducing the checkout slowdowns store associates saw during the busiest periods.
Documented troubleshooting procedures and verification steps for retail deployments, so support engineers could reproduce and confirm a fix without escalating back to the product team.
